svg.title: Choose the Payment Route Before Migrating
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-05-payment-provider-readiness-gates; chapter number: 5; title: Choose the Payment Route Before Migrating; subtitle: Check eligibility, tax responsibility, product operations, and payout timing before relying on a replacement checkout.; caption: Gaurav Tiwari prioritizes seller eligibility and license keys; SoloBuild compares tax administration and payout terms; OCH Platform distinguishes Stripe Tax activation from a Stripe connection; heyymilian identifies missing product-delivery functions.; assumptions note: These are Gaurav Tiwari, SoloBuild, OCH Platform, and heyymilian's reported checks. Eligibility, coverage, and pricing depend on the provider and product configuration; a payment connection alone does not establish tax handling.; note: Gaurav Tiwari recommends retaining control of the customer list, license server, and checkout links. SoloBuild reports a $100 Paddle payout minimum and monthly payment by the fifteenth.; chart type: decision_tree; nodes: gate: G1; question: Does the destination accept the seller location and intended product?; pass next: G2; fail action: Choose an eligible destination before migrating. Gaurav Tiwari reports that their India-based plugin business is excluded from the Managed Payments path they discuss.; gate: G2; question: Are tax responsibility, coverage, and the administrative trade-off understood?; pass next: G3; fail action: Compare filing time and accountant costs with the handoff premium as SoloBuild recommends. For the Stripe Tax route, follow OCH Platform's separate dashboard and integration activation.; gate: G3; question: Are delivery, license keys, download links, storefront functions, and affiliates accounted for?; pass next: G4; fail action: Arrange the missing functions before switching. heyymilian says Managed Payments does not include these Lemon Squeezy functions; Gaurav Tiwari puts existing license keys ahead of promotional fees.; gate: G4; question: Do payout timing and minimum balances fit the business?; pass next: Proceed with the eligible route and the accounted-for delivery and licensing arrangements.; fail action: Reconsider the provider or cash timing before depending on payouts. SoloBuild reports Paddle's monthly schedule and $100 minimum.

text.tspan: Choose the Payment Route Before Migrating

circle.title: gate: G1; question: Does the destination accept the seller location and intended product?; pass next: G2; fail action: Choose an eligible destination before migrating. Gaurav Tiwari reports that their India-based plugin business is excluded from the Managed Payments path they discuss.

gate: G2; question: Are tax responsibility, coverage, and the administrative trade-off understood?; pass next: G3; fail action: Compare filing time and accountant costs with the handoff premium as SoloBuild recommends. For the Stripe Tax route, follow OCH Platform's separate dashboard and integration activation.

gate: G3; question: Are delivery, license keys, download links, storefront functions, and affiliates accounted for?; pass next: G4; fail action: Arrange the missing functions before switching. heyymilian says Managed Payments does not include these Lemon Squeezy functions; Gaurav Tiwari puts existing license keys ahead of promotional fees.

gate: G4; question: Do payout timing and minimum balances fit the business?; pass next: Proceed with the eligible route and the accounted-for delivery and licensing arrangements.; fail action: Reconsider the provider or cash timing before depending on payouts. SoloBuild reports Paddle's monthly schedule and $100 minimum.

text.title: Assumptions: These are Gaurav Tiwari, SoloBuild, OCH Platform, and heyymilian's reported checks. Eligibility, coverage, and pricing depend on the provider and product configuration; a payment connection alone does not establish tax handling.
